defs.d: The different ideal.
Not the same; exhibiting a difference.
Various, assorted, diverse.
Differently.
A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
defs.ex: His parents got him an in with the company.

defs.d: (chiefly in the plural) One who, or that which, is in; especially, one who is in office.
To enclose.
To take in; to harvest.
Located indoors, especially at home or at one's office or place of work.
defs.ex: Is Mr. Smith in?

defs.d: Located inside something.
defs.ex: Little by little I pushed the snake into the basket, until finally all of it was in.

defs.d: To engage the attention of; to awaken interest in; to excite emotion or passion in, in behalf of a person or thing.
defs.ex: Action films don't really interest me.

defs.d: To be concerned with or engaged in; to affect; to concern; to excite.
Having or showing interest.
defs.ex: I'm very interested in going to see that play.

defs.d: Motivated by considerations of self-interest; self-serving.
Given to expending a lot of money; profligate, lavish.
Having a high price or cost.
Something trifling, or of no consequence or importance.
A trivial remark (especially in the term sweet nothings).
Not at all; in no way.
Not any thing; no thing.
An absence of anything, including empty space, brightness, darkness, matter, or a vacuum.
A percussive keyboard musical instrument, usually ranging over seven octaves, with white and black colored keys, played by pressing these keys, causing hammers to strike strings
defs.ex: He can play "Happy Birthday" on the piano.

defs.d: Soft, quiet
In extended use; quiet, subdued
Television, television show, movie.
A short film clip, with or without audio (as in a music video, or one of the plethora of user-generated short movies on sites such as YouTube).
To record using a video camera, to videotape
To record a television program
A hard-shelled seed.
defs.ex: There are many sort of nuts: peanuts, cashews, pistachios, Brazil nuts and more.

defs.d: A piece of metal, usually square or hexagonal in shape, with a hole through it having machined internal threads, intended to be screwed onto a bolt or other threaded shaft.
(mostly in the form "nutting") To gather nuts.
To hit deliberately with the head; to headbutt.
To cause to feel fear; to scare; to cause to feel alarm or fright.
defs.ex: Avery puts a sheet over her head, pretending to be a ghost to frighten Emily.

defs.d: To design (a building, machine, etc.).
defs.ex: The architect planned the building for the client.

defs.d: To create a plan for.
defs.ex: They jointly planned the project in phases, with good detail for the first month.

defs.d: Action of the verb to plan.
The act of formulating of a course of action, or of drawing up plans.
A mixture of mineral particles and organic material, used to support plant growth.
The unconsolidated mineral or organic material on the immediate surface of the earth that serves as a natural medium for the growth of land plants.
A building, wing or dependency set apart and adapted for lodging and feeding (and training) animals with hoofs, especially horses.
defs.ex: There were stalls for fourteen horses in the squire's stables.

defs.d: (metonymy) All the racehorses of a particular stable, i.e. belonging to a given owner.
A long, thin and flexible structure made from threads twisted together.
Such a structure considered as a substance.
To put (items) on a string.
defs.ex: You can string these beads on to this cord to make a colorful necklace.

defs.d: To put strings on (something).
defs.ex: It is difficult to string a tennis racket properly.

defs.d: Having to do with people and government office as opposed to the military or religion.
defs.ex: She went into civil service because she wanted to help the people.

defs.d: Behaving in a reasonable or polite manner.
defs.ex: It was very civil of him to stop the argument.

defs.d: Which of two.
Introducing a direct interrogative question (often with correlative or) which indicates doubt between alternatives.
Used to introduce an indirect interrogative question that consists of multiple alternative possibilities (usually with correlative or).
defs.ex: He chose the correct answer, but I don't know whether it was by luck or (whether it was) by skill.

defs.d: The state or characteristic of being just or fair.
defs.ex: the justice of a description

defs.d: The ideal of fairness, impartiality, etc., especially with regard to the punishment of wrongdoing.
defs.ex: Justice was served.

defs.d: A thing or being, event or process, perceptible through senses; or a fact or occurrence thereof.
(by extension) A knowable thing or event (eg by inference, especially in science)
defs.ex: An electromagnetic phenomenon.

defs.d: A political upheaval in a government or nation state characterized by great change.
The removal and replacement of a government, especially by sudden violent action.
A sticky note, such as a post-it note.
defs.ex: Her desk is covered with yellow stickies.

defs.d: A discussion thread fixed at the top of the list of topics or threads so as to keep it in view.
(bulletin boards) to fix a thread at the top of the list of topics or threads so as to keep it in view.
Able or likely to stick.
defs.ex: Is this tape sticky enough to stay on that surface?

defs.d: Potentially difficult to escape from.
defs.ex: This is a sticky situation. We could be in this for weeks if we're not careful.
